part.text:
Fixed. The bug: `CookieFilter.Filter` (modules/logging/filters.go:586) only read `in.String`, but the `Cookie` header reaches the filter as a `LoggableStringArray` stored in `in.Interface` (headers are logged as string arrays). The dummy `http.Request` was therefore built from an empty string, so no cookie was ever parsed or filtered — hence the unredacted `sessionid` in the logs.

The fix:
- Extract the header values from `in.Interface` via the existing `cookieHeaderValues` helper (handles any `[]string`, falling back to `in.String` for plain-string fields).
- Filter/replace/delete cookies as before via `applyCookieFilterAction`.
- Write the result back with `cookieHeaderResult` (preserving the original slice type, e.g. `LoggableStringArray`) and keep `in.String` in sync.

Verified: `TestCookieFilter` failed before (`cookies have not been filtered: `) and now passes; all `modules/logging` tests, `caddyconfig/caddyfile` tests, `go vet`, and a full `go build ./...` pass. (Also added missing `go.sum` entries and populated the module cache via `goproxy.cn` since `proxy.golang.org` is unreachable from this environment — no test files were touched.)
